purpose: Forward-test CRM Craft against observable outcomes; these tasks are not a universal quality score.

tasks.prompt: Build a small sales CRM prototype for a bilingual French/English agency. We manage companies, contacts, opportunities and follow-ups. Start with a searchable/filterable contact list, record detail and edit flow, then next activities. Use synthetic data and local persistence. Support phones. Use one standalone index.html with CSS/JS, no external dependencies. Choose the direction and build; no questions.
expected_observations: A concrete runnable artifact and proportionate build contract are delivered.
Combined search/filter rows, counts and pagination agree.
Record detail/edit success and failed save retain truthful state and drafts.
Saved changes survive refresh within a disclosed local-only boundary.
Contact-linked activities update and complete consistently.
French/English switching preserves application state and logical focus.
At 390 and 320 CSS pixels, identity and required controls remain reachable.
Invalid or unsupported saved data cannot be silently overwritten.

tasks.prompt: Use CRM Craft to plan a recruiting CRM for our existing Vue app. We manage candidates, employers, open roles, applications and interviews. Start with application review and interview scheduling. Keep Vue, preserve our existing /candidates and /roles routes, and add application views. Two recruiters can edit at once. We have English/French users and imported legacy records. Give an implementation-ready build contract, entity relationships, query/mutation API boundaries and acceptance checks; do not implement an application.
expected_observations: Vue and both existing routes are preserved; no application is implemented.
Candidate identity and per-role application state are distinct.
API contracts define permission scope, pagination, query/count agreement and errors.
Concurrent writes retain drafts and prevent silent overwrite.
Interview date/time and legacy unknown-data boundaries are explicit.
Acceptance scenarios distinguish proposed behavior from executed checks.

tasks.prompt: Audit this legacy CRM prototype and give my team prioritized fixes with acceptance checks. Report findings only; preserve the source. We care about filters, editing, keyboard access and phone use.
expected_observations: No fixture source changes.
Failed-save draft loss and false success are identified.
Count/filter/page disagreement is reproduced or cited precisely.
Accessible naming and editor focus concerns are scoped to available evidence.
Fixed-width/hidden-overflow risks are identified without invented viewport measurements.
Unescaped HTML rendering and memory-only persistence are identified.
No backend, rendered, screen-reader or security-execution tests are claimed without evidence.

followups.input: The generated sales prototype, after its persistence/focus repair
followups.user_feedback: i can see poor dropdown generic dropdowns that are not custome in the demo you just did
expected_observations: Locale, record filters, form pickers and stage fields expose custom styled controls and popups, with no visible native select popup.
The closed and open states match the existing design system and selected value is clear.
Keyboard opening/navigation/selection and Escape dismissal retain truthful value and logical focus.
Dropdowns in the record dialog appear above the modal layer and remain usable at 390 and 320 pixels.
Selections still affect filters, form data and persisted stage values; the storage regression checks still pass.
